keyframes.prompt: Vertical 2:3 macro photo, split-level view exactly at the water line of a calm pond, shot through clear glass. The water line runs horizontally across the middle of the frame. Upper half: air above the water, soft out-of-focus green reeds. Lower half: clear greenish water with a soft dark background and a few tiny floating particles. Left of center, a clump of frogspawn floats at the water surface: about 40 round clear jelly eggs, each with a small black dot inside. Right of center, a round green lily pad floats flat on the water surface. Soft diffused daylight, shallow depth of field. Keep everything important away from the left and right edges. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the pond, water line, lily pad, background, lighting and camera angle exactly the same. The frogspawn jelly is now empty, with no black dots. Three small dark tadpoles swim just below the water surface: the middle one in sharp focus at the center of the frame, the other two smaller and slightly out of focus to the left and right.

Edit this image. Keep the pond, water line, lily pad, empty jelly, background, lighting, camera angle and the two out-of-focus tadpoles exactly the same. The middle tadpole is now bigger, with two small back legs at the base of its tail, in the same spot.

Edit this image. Keep the pond, water line, lily pad, empty jelly, background, lighting, camera angle and the two out-of-focus tadpoles exactly the same. The middle tadpole is now a young froglet with four legs and a short tail stub, at the water surface in the same spot, with its head just above the water line.

Edit this image. Keep the pond, water line, lily pad, empty jelly, background, lighting, camera angle and the two out-of-focus tadpoles exactly the same. Remove the froglet. An adult common frog sits on the lily pad, facing the camera. The whole frog fits inside the frame, away from the left and right edges.

clips.prompt: Static camera. Time-lapse. The black eggs slowly hatch and small tadpoles wriggle out into the water. Nothing else changes.
Static camera. Time-lapse. The middle tadpole slowly grows bigger and grows two back legs. The other two tadpoles stay in place. Nothing else changes.
Static camera. Time-lapse. The middle tadpole slowly grows front legs while its tail shrinks, becoming a young froglet. The other two tadpoles stay in place. Nothing else changes.
Static camera. Time-lapse. The young froglet slowly climbs onto the lily pad and grows into an adult frog. The other two tadpoles stay in place. Nothing else changes.
